title: Paros the Lovely
description: Six artists with a close connection to the island show Paros as it was. Paros the Lovely (Η Πάρος η Ωραία) is what the island was called in ancient times.
imageAlt: A colorful painting of villagers dancing and feasting on Paros, from Paros the Lovely

about: Paros the Lovely (Η Πάρος η Ωραία), as the island was called in ancient times, was the summer exhibition at Holland Tunnel Gallery in Parikia, with six artists who have a close connection to Paros. Their work reflects and visualizes life on the island as it was.
The gallery was open Wednesday through Saturday evenings, 8:30–11 pm, and by appointment.

program.text: Closing reception: a last look at the work as summer winds down
